youtube_description:
Today my buddy Blake and I are taking our hardtails to the Post Canyon mountain bike trail system in Hood River, Oregon. If you are in the Portland area, these trails can be found by heading East bound for about an hour on I-84 towards Hood River. It’s a decent drive but it runs along the Columbia River where you can see stunning views of the water and even get a glimpse of Multnomah Falls. 

Post Canyon is an incredibly designed trail system with drops, jumps, tech, and some of the best flow I’ve ever ridden. In today’s video you will see us sessioning the Middle School jump line, hitting our biggest drop yet at the beginning of Drop Out, a nice flowy POV of Float on, and a little bit of Upper Grand Prix. Unfortunately, Grand Prix would be our last run of the day due to my gnarly crash on a step up. I did go back up and clear it before we left but I was ready to save the other trails for another day after that!

Like, Subscribe, and check out my other videos! Thank you for watching!
